name: Velodrome
notes: Colored: the official brand-kit symbol.svg unchanged (two interlocking rings striped #FF1100, #FDBF41, #F1ECE2 and #007FFF, with the kit's 48% #191919 shadow gradient), placed on the 64 grid

Mono: the same paths in the same painting order inside a mask, read by luminance: the #FF1100 and #007FFF stripes are full ink, the #FDBF41 stripes 40% ink (mask fill #666), the near-white #F1ECE2 stripes knocked out, and the shadow dropped, so each ring keeps its striped ribbon
